description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
